Only 57 fixed-point checks out of 3000 trials — the acceptance rate is low. Let me write a dedicated "valid chain" fuzzer that generates requests that are much more likely to be accepted, to exercise multi-hop semantics and the fixed-point property more heavily.

Let me create a generator where:
- directory has a few identities with aliases (sip and tel)
- accounts with primary/allow
- gateways with local_domains and peers
- From chosen from the allowed aliases (or anonymous), PPI chosen from allowed aliases or omitted, PAI for peer jobs chosen from aliases in the peer's authority, etc.

Then verify chains. Actually, the fixed-point check is the most valuable: for an accepted job, re-submitting the wire with the same context yields the same result (when PAI is emitted for peer, or nonanonymous From for local).

Let me write a focused valid-request generator and run a big loop. This mainly double-checks the identity selection and privacy logic.

Let me write it.

import json, random, sys, os
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp/t')
import h2
if os.environ.get('INPROC'):
    import importlib.util
    _spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('gw', '/workspace/submission/gateway.py')
    _gw = importlib.util.module_from_spec(_spec); _spec.loader.exec_module(_gw)
    h2.run = _gw.process_batch
from h2 import *

ID = ['sip:a@x.test', 'sip:b@y.test', 'sip:c@z.test']
DIR2 = {'sip:a@x.test': ['tel:+15550001', 'sip:al@x.test'],
        'sip:b@y.test': ['tel:+15550002', 'sip:bl@y.test'],
        'sip:c@z.test': ['tel:+15550003']}
ACC2 = {'s1': {'primary': 'sip:a@x.test', 'allow': ['sip:b@y.test', 'sip:c@z.test']},
        's2': {'primary': 'sip:b@y.test', 'allow': []},
        's3': {'primary': 'sip:c@z.test', 'allow': ['sip:a@x.test']}}
GW2 = {'g1': {'local_domains': ['x.test', 'y.test'], 'peers': {'p2': ['z.test'], 'p1': ['x.test']}},
       'g2': {'local_domains': ['z.test'], 'peers': {'p1': ['x.test', 'y.test']}},
       'g3': {'local_domains': [], 'peers': {'p1': ['x.test', 'y.test', 'z.test'], 'p2': ['z.test']}}}
CTX4 = (DIR2, ACC2, GW2)

ALIAS = {'sip:a@x.test': ['sip:a@x.test','sip:AL@x.test','sip:%61l@x.test','tel:+15550001'],
         'sip:b@y.test': ['sip:b@y.test','tel:+15550002','sip:bl@y.test'],
         'sip:c@z.test': ['sip:c@z.test','tel:+15550003']}
def addr(can, tag=None):
    forms = ['<%s>' % can, can, 'Bob <' + can + '>', '"Q,\\" x" <' + can + '>']
    s = random.choice(forms)
    if tag is not None and random.random() < 0.7:
        s += random.choice([';tag=' + tag, ' ;tag = ' + tag])
    return s
def request(kind, subject, peer, gwname, trusted):
    body = random.choice(['hi','','x'*10,'a\r\nb'])
    hdrs = []
    if random.random() < 0.15:
        frm = 'sip:anonymous@anonymous.invalid'
        from_anon = True
    else:
        can = random.choice(ID)
        if kind == 'local':
            acct = ACC2[subject]
            if can not in [acct['primary']] + acct['allow']:
                can = acct['primary']
        else:
            can = random.choice(ID)
        frm = addr(can, random.choice(['t1','T2']))
        from_anon = False
    hdrs.append('From: ' + frm)
    hdrs.append('To: ' + addr(random.choice(ID), random.choice([None,'R9'])))
    hdrs.append('Call-ID: ' + random.choice(['c1','x.y_z@1']))
    hdrs.append('CSeq: ' + random.choice(['1','00042']) + ' ' + random.choice([' MESSAGE','  MESSAGE','\tMESSAGE']))
    hdrs.append('Content-Length: %d' % len(body))
    if kind == 'peer' or random.random() < 0.5:
        can = random.choice(ID)
        if kind == 'peer' and random.random() < 0.8:
            auth = GW2[gwname]['peers'][peer]
            cand = [c for c in ID if DIR2[c].__class__ and c.split('@')[1].split('@')[0] in auth]
            if cand: can = random.choice(cand)
        if kind == 'local' and random.random() < 0.8:
            can = ACC2[subject]['primary']
        forms = ['<%s>' % can, can, '"D" <' + can + '>']
        if random.random() < 0.3:
            other = [c for c in ID if c != can]
            o = random.choice(other)
            if can.startswith('sip:'):
                pair = '<%s>, <%s>' % (can, 'tel:' + DIR2[o][0].split(':')[1] if o in DIR2 else can)
            else:
                pair = '<%s>, <%s>' % (can, can)
            forms.append(pair)
        hdrs.append('P-Asserted-Identity: ' + random.choice(forms))
    if random.random() < 0.3:
        can = ACC2[subject]['primary'] if kind == 'local' else random.choice(ID)
        hdrs.append('P-Preferred-Identity: ' + addr(can))
    if random.random() < 0.2:
        hdrs.append('Remote-Party-ID: ' + addr(random.choice(ID)))
    if random.random() < 0.35:
        hdrs.append('Privacy: ' + random.choice(['id','none','ID']))
    if random.random() < 0.4:
        hdrs.append('Content-Type: ' + random.choice(['text/plain','application/sdp;a=1']))
    random.shuffle(hdrs)
    return '\r\n'.join(['MESSAGE ' + random.choice(['sip:d@relay.test','sip:D@RELAY.TEST.']) + ' SIP/2.0'] + hdrs) + '\r\n\r\n' + body

checked = 0; mismatch = 0; accepted = 0
for trial in range(4000):
    kind = random.choice(['local','peer','peer'])
    gwname = random.choice(['g1','g2','g3'])
    subject = random.choice(['s1','s2','s3'])
    peer = random.choice(['p1','p2'])
    trusted = random.random() < 0.6
    rq = request(kind, subject, peer, gwname, trusted)
    j = {'gateway': gwname, 'trusted_out': trusted,
         'ingress': {'kind': kind, **({'subject': subject} if kind=='local' else {'name': peer})},
         'raw': rq}
    res = h2.run({'directory': DIR2, 'accounts': ACC2, 'gateways': GW2, 'jobs': [j]})['results'][0]
    if res['status'] != 'accept':
        continue
    accepted += 1
    wire = res['wire']
    ok = False
    if kind == 'local' and not res['private']:
        j2 = {'gateway': gwname, 'trusted_out': trusted, 'ingress': {'kind':'local','subject':subject}, 'raw': wire}
        exp = {'identity': res['identity'], 'basis':'local', 'private': False}
        ok = True
    elif kind == 'peer' and 'P-Asserted-Identity' in wire:
        j2 = {'gateway': gwname, 'trusted_out': trusted, 'ingress': {'kind':'peer','name':peer}, 'raw': wire}
        exp = {'identity': res['identity'], 'basis':'peer', 'private': res['private']}
        ok = True
    if not ok:
        continue
    checked += 1
    r2 = h2.run({'directory': DIR2, 'accounts': ACC2, 'gateways': GW2, 'jobs': [j2]})['results'][0]
    if r2['status'] != 'accept' or any(r2.get(k) != v for k,v in exp.items()) or r2['wire'] != wire:
        mismatch += 1
        print('MISMATCH')
        print(' wire:', repr(wire))
        print(' res0:', json.dumps(res))
        print(' res1:', json.dumps(r2))
        if mismatch > 2: break
print('accepted', accepted, 'checked', checked, 'mismatch', mismatch)
